note: Agreements under which wages are taxed only in the state where the employee lives. Only states whose own documents list their partners are included.

source.label: Michigan Department of Treasury, withholding reciprocity (MCL 206.256)

states.name: Minnesota
states.note: It works both ways: a Minnesota resident working in either state, and a resident of either state working in Minnesota, is taxed only at home.

source.label: Minnesota Department of Revenue, reciprocity for individuals

states.name: Virginia
states.note: If Virginia tax was withheld anyway, you get it back by filing Form 763-S — you do not file a full Virginia return.

states.name: New Jersey
states.note: The agreement covers wages only. Income from a business, or from selling something, is not part of it.

source.label: New Jersey Division of Taxation, PA/NJ reciprocal income tax agreement
